api.result: One canonical absolute Path. Callers must pass this exact result unchanged to downstream state_lock, state/ledger path construction, and channel APIs.
api.legacy_behavior: value=None resolves the existing legacy default home.
api.nonlegacy_behavior: Any selectable nonlegacy home refuses with ControlHomeError until a separately authorized coherent authority-state/ledger establishment schema and marker are defined.
api.prohibited_assumption: An absent directory, empty ledger, config, observer, queue, lock, or delivery fallback never establishes authority.

flow_integration.required_future_pattern: Resolve once before the first control-state path/lock operation; pass the resulting Path unchanged through the flow call chain.
flow_integration.not_in_this_card: bos_flow.py edit, authority establishment, cutover, migration, runtime activation, or state inspection.

channel_api.public_function: deliver(target, prompt, message_id, home=HOME_DIR, *, model=None, thinking=None)
channel_api.ordering: Public deliver resolves/refuses home before it constructs AppTools. Internal _deliver_resolved(client, ..., home) is for this module only after an already-safe resolver boundary.
channel_api.compatibility_boundary: The former public client-first deliver(client, ...) signature is intentionally removed. Unreviewed external callers must not pass pre-created AppTools; their migration is a separate exact scope.

finality: Interface is a static source contract only and may change only through independent review.
